finding: The Train-inner Bar Base/Stress diagnostic computed filled_quote_notional as native fill quantity times price and omitted the frozen contract multiplier. Reports for multiplier-above-one instruments therefore understated simulated fill notional.
changes: The diagnostic order summarizer now requires one finite positive Decimal contract multiplier and applies it to every fill's quote notional.
Each mode passes HistoricalEnvironmentFactory.contract_multiplier from the frozen instrument rule and records the multiplier alongside the computed notional.
Added synthetic multiplier-2 and invalid-multiplier regressions.
